Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Yogesh Ranade. I am a 50-year-old shopkeeper living in Hyderabad. I paid M/s Harbour Realty ₹7,29,00,000 for a flat, and the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 94525 65261 or email yogesh.ranade28@example.com.
